hints.title: Formula Decomposition
hints.text: The pair score formula values[i] + values[j] + i - j can be separated into two independent terms: (values[i] + i) and (values[j] - j).

hints.title: Maintain Running Best Prefix
hints.text: As the second index j moves forward from 1 to n - 1, maintain the maximum value of (values[i] + i) encountered so far among all previous indices i < j.

hints.title: Single-Pass Evaluation
hints.text: Initialize best prefix with values[0] + 0. At each step j, maximize the overall answer with best prefix + values[j] - j, then update best prefix with values[j] + j.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every pair (i, j) with i < j takes O(N^2) time, leading to time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Decoupling indices into prefix and current terms eliminates nested loops in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that separating the expression allows tracking the max prefix term in a single pass.
complexity.notes: Operates as a 1D DP with state compressed to a single scalar variable.
